data_sources.base: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station CSV files
unit_limits: TMAX/TMIN/TAVG tenths of degrees Celsius divided by 10
AWND and WSF tenths of metres per second divided by 10
RH values divided by 10 when sourced as tenths of percent
ASLP/ASTP tenths of hectopascals divided by 10
Missing values remain missing; no target-driven interpolation used

methodology.station_held_out: Each station omitted completely; remaining stations use an 80/20 chronological validation split
methodology.rolling_features: Station-local shifted precipitation only; no station boundary or future target leakage
methodology.same_day_weather: Temperature, wind, humidity and pressure are observations on the prediction date; next-day precipitation is never used as an input
